I replied to Tobias in a thread under his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api. The depot was **Southgate**.

The answer comes from the incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 at 14:06, Pree posted that label printing had stalled and that Southgate dispatch had unlabelled totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 she posted that labels were printing again and Southgate had cleared the backlog.

I couldn't find a street address or any other site details for Southgate. The shared account folders came back empty, so I told Tobias that and suggested he ask Pree or Hollis if he needs more for the customer call.
